infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your camera so you can take photos of your school worksheets and homework assignments to send directly to your teacher.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your microphone so you can record and send audio messages directly to your classmates and teachers.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your photos so you can select and upload homework assignments, worksheets, and profile pictures from your photo library.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to save worksheets, class schedules, and study materials directly to your photo library.
